newsitem.title: CANADA: Newcourt unit launches capital lending fund.
newsitem.headline: Newcourt unit launches capital lending fund.

text.p: Newcourt Credit Group Inc said on Tuesday its Newcourt Capital unit launched a US$500-million fund for financing major capital projets in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.

Newcourt Capital said the project finance fund's lead institutional investors are CIGNA Investments, John Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co and New York Life Insurance Co with US$75 million each. Newcourt is investing US$50 million in the fund, which it will manage.

The fund is available for projects in the fields of energy and petrochemicals, forest products, infrastructure, metals and mining, power and telecommunications. Project sizes will range from US$40 million to US$100 million, with larger financings possible through a co-investment with fund investors.
